'''Communications chief''' was a position held during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Chief/Legends|chief]] [[Hurdiss]] served as the communications chief aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].
